heroHeadline: Sweida Druze Rally with Israeli Flags as Damascus Protests Israeli Incursions
heroSubtitle: On October 4 Damascus condemned Israel's continued incursions, a completed buffer-zone line and its hold on Mount Hermon. On October 7, followers of Druze leader Hikmat al-Hijri rallied with Israeli flags in Sweida, drawing local condemnation.
